'''Timna''' was an [[Amayar]] resident on [[Tremalking]]. 

== Activities ==
During the [[cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']], she views the hand of the female [[Choedan Kal]] glowing with brilliance, which makes her smile, knowing that the [[Time of Illusion]] is at an end. Timna is presumed dead after the mass suicide of the Amayar.{{ref/book|9|35}}
